name: pinterest-inspiration
description: Zero-config visual inspiration MCP plugin with built-in frontend design taste and web interface accessibility skills. Scrapes top Pinterest pins, extracts dominant hex colors and dimensions, generates anti-slop Tailwind/React UI, and crafts precision AI prompts.
author: Antigravity Team
suggestedPrompts: Find visual inspiration for a minimalist modern coffee shop landing page and build it using design-taste-frontend
Show me Pinterest moodboards for luxury perfume editorial branding and audit the UI with web-design-guidelines
Search Pinterest for brutalist typography posters and download the top image for multimodal inspection
